title: Ptolemaic Tabula Europae covering Dacia and Moesia
creator: After Claudius Ptolemy; engraver varies by edition
atlas_context: A Ptolemy edition; which one determines everything else
notes: Tabula Europae numbering differs between the Bologna, Rome, Ulm, Strasbourg, Mercator and later editions, and the plate covering Dacia is not the same number in all of them. Nothing here may be filled in from a general recollection of Ptolemy: the edition is named first, then its own numbering is read, then the dossier is completed.

title: Mercator-Hondius plate of Transylvania or ancient Dacia
creator: Gerard Mercator; continued by Jodocus Hondius and successors
atlas_context: The Mercator-Hondius Atlas and its many issues
notes: The plates were reissued for decades with reworked text on the verso, so state is determined by the verso setting rather than by the image. Which issue a candidate belongs to is the whole question and is unresolved here.

title: Sanson map of ancient Dacia, Moesia and Thrace
creator: Nicolas Sanson d'Abbeville
atlas_context: Sanson's historical geography of the ancient world
notes: Sanson's ancient-world sheets were reissued by Mariette and later by Jaillot with altered imprints. The imprint is the state evidence and has not been checked for any candidate.

title: Zatta plate of Transylvania or the Danubian provinces
creator: Antonio Zatta
notes: Late, common and usually well preserved, which makes this the family where condition and colour state matter more than rarity. Original versus later colour is the first thing to establish.

title: Homann map of Wallachia and the Danubian frontier
creator: Johann Baptist Homann and heirs
notes: Homann sheets circulate both as atlas leaves and as separately sold prints, and the house continued as Homann Erben after 1730. Whether a candidate carries the Homann or the Erben imprint dates it and is unverified here.

title: Schwantz von Springfels survey of Habsburg Oltenia
creator: Friedrich Schwantz von Springfels
notes: The dossier the programme needs whether or not a copy is ever purchasable: this is the survey that corresponds to the pp-oltenia-1718 phase in the principalities layer, and a scholarly account of it is worth having even if no sheet reaches the collection. Acquisition status is not_sought and says nothing about its value as a source.
